newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudis sticking to OPEC quota - Gulf sources.
newsitem.headline: Saudis sticking to OPEC quota - Gulf sources.

text.p: Saudi Arabia is sticking to its Organisation of Petroleum Exporting Countries (OPEC) quota of 8.0 million barrels per day, Gulf sources said on Tuesday.

"Saudi Arabia is currently sticking to its quota and will not change it except within OPEC," a Gulf source told Reuters. "The U.S. has not requested any oil producing country to intervene in the oil market."

The source was denying a news agency report that Riyadh had been asked to increase its oil production to compensate for the loss of Iraqi oil sales after an expected oil-for-food deal was delayed by the United Nations. Recent tensions in northern Iraq raised the question about the safety of inspectors and monitors implementing the deal.
Oil markets fell heavily on the report that Washington had asked the world's largest oil exporter to increase its output.
